specification.objective: Prevent the persistent project/task workspace ghosting and overlapping-frame defect observed on Firefox by avoiding the CanvasKit WebGL path on Firefox while preserving the normal renderer configuration for other browsers.

requirements.statement: Flutter web bootstrap must detect Firefox at runtime from navigator.userAgent.
Firefox must initialize CanvasKit with canvasKitForceCpuOnly enabled so rendering does not depend on WebGL compositing.
Non-Firefox browsers must keep canvasKitForceCpuOnly disabled and retain the normal GPU-capable path.
The web bootstrap must remain compatible with Flutter's generated flutter_js and flutter_build_config placeholders and continue calling _flutter.loader.load exactly once.
The locked POLIS Change Contract must be versioned at docs/contracts/project-tasks-layout-overlap-fix-v2.polis.json.

acceptance_criteria.statement: frontend/web/flutter_bootstrap.js contains the Flutter bootstrap placeholders, Firefox detection, and canvasKitForceCpuOnly bound to the Firefox predicate.
A frontend test protects the Firefox CPU-rendering bootstrap policy.
No backend, project/task domain, authorization, persistence, or API behavior changes.
The locked schema-v4 contract is included under docs/contracts/project-tasks-layout-overlap-fix-v2.polis.json.

invariants.statement: Project/task and Kanban application behavior remains unchanged.
The workaround is limited to Flutter Web engine initialization.
No new package dependency is introduced.

forbidden_states.statement: canvasKitForceCpuOnly is enabled unconditionally for every browser.
Firefox continues using the WebGL CanvasKit path after bootstrap.
The change modifies application business logic or project/task layout code.

inputs.statement: Flutter Web startup in Firefox and non-Firefox browsers.

outputs.statement: Firefox starts CanvasKit in CPU-only mode.
Other browsers keep the default GPU-capable CanvasKit behavior.

failure_semantics.statement: If the Firefox renderer fallback is absent or unconditional, the regression command fails closed with firefox_cpu_renderer_policy_missing.

argv: from pathlib import Path; import sys; p=Path('web/flutter_bootstrap.js'); s=p.read_text() if p.exists() else ''; ok=('{{flutter_js}}' in s and '{{flutter_build_config}}' in s and "navigator.userAgent.includes('Firefox')" in s and 'canvasKitForceCpuOnly: isFirefox' in s and s.count('_flutter.loader.load(')==1); print('firefox_cpu_renderer_policy_ok' if ok else 'firefox_cpu_renderer_policy_missing'); sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
